_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible all with the purpose of securing clean water and energy to the maximum number of people. Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week. But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

The Opportunity

Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for an engineer to join our team.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll help model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

What You Will Do

• 
Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• 
Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• 
Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• 
Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• 
Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• 
Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• 
Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• 
Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

What You Could Bring

• 
2+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• 
Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language.

• 
Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• 
Experience with API design and integrating with third-party APIs.

• 
Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders.

• 
A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code.

• 
Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Join Charlie Tango, a specialised unit within KMD

Charlie Tango is a multidisciplinary consultancy within KMD, bringing together around 40 specialists across design, strategy, technology, AI and innovation.

Together, we combine Charlie Tango’s hands-on approach to design and innovation with KMD’s deep domain knowledge and experience developing critical digital solutions that help shape the future of society.

AI is transforming how we explore ideas, create experiences and build digital products. At the same time, growing complexity demands stronger design systems, smarter processes and a more systematic approach to design.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is excited by both. Someone with excellent visual and UI design skills, a strong understanding of UX, and a genuine passion for design craft, combined with a deep interest in the systems, processes and practices that enable great design at scale.

Be part of our multidisciplinary design team

You will join our Product Design team, part of Charlie Tango’s Experience Design department of approximately 15 designers, spanning UX, Service Design, UI, Motion Design and Branding.

Your primary focus will be on UI, interaction design and design systems, working closely with our Service & UX Design team, frontend developers and product owners.

Your role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will take a leading role in shaping digital products, experiences and

the practices behind them.

You will take ownership of the design process, working from user needs and business challenges

through concepts, interactions and high-quality visual execution.

You are a hands-on designer who can navigate complex challenges, facilitate collaboration and advise clients on how to improve their design

practices.

With a particular focus on Process Design, Design Systems, DesignOps and Accessibility, you will help

organisations develop and implement better ways of working, while remaining closely involved in the

design work itself.

Your work will typically include:

• Creating digital products and interfaces. Develop high-quality visual and interaction design,

from concepts and prototypes to detailed UI and production-ready designs.

• Designing processes and ways of working. Map workflows, identify challenges and develop

practical processes that improve collaboration, decision-making and delivery.

• Building and evolving Design Systems. Develop components, design standards and governance

models, and help organisations implement and adopt them.

• Advancing DesignOps and Accessibility. Help clients establish effective design practices,

accessibility standards and processes that support consistent, inclusive digital experiences.

• Facilitating and advising. Lead workshops, collaborate with stakeholders and translate complex

needs into clear design directions and practical solutions.

• Exploring AI in design. Use AI-assisted tools and automation in your own work, experiment with

new workflows and help clients identify opportunities to improve their design processes.

• Developing our design practice. Share knowledge, challenge existing methods and contribute to

the development of our Experience Design team.

What you bring

We imagine you have 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally from a consultancy, agency or

complex product organisation. You are first and foremost a skilled visual and digital product designer,

with a portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, attention to detail and experience creating digital

products and working with large-scale design systems.

In detail:

• Excellent visual and UI design skills, including typography, colour, layout, interaction patterns,

prototyping and detailed interface design.

• A strong understanding of UX, user behaviour and the principles of human-centred design.

• A systematic and analytical mindset, with a genuine interest in Process Design, workflows and

improving how teams work.

• Practical experience with Design Systems and DesignOps, including components, governance,

implementation and cross-functional collaboration.

• Deep accessibility expertise, including WCAG and the ability to independently advise on inclusive

design and its implementation.

• Strong facilitation and consultancy skills, with the confidence to work directly with clients and

multidisciplinary teams.

• Advanced Figma skills, and an active interest in AI-assisted design workflows and emerging

technologies.

• Excellent communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Why join Charlie Tango?

At Charlie Tango, you become part of a close-knit specialist environment with the reach and

opportunities of a major technology organisation as part of KMD.

You will work on meaningful digital challenges across public and private sectors, including solutions that

support essential functions in Danish society. You will collaborate with experienced designers, advisors

and engineers in an environment that values craft, curiosity, precision and new ideas.

You will also join at a time when AI and emerging technologies are changing both what we design and

how we design it, creating opportunities to explore new approaches and influence the future of our

practice.

We offer a high degree of professional autonomy, varied challenges and opportunities for professional

development and knowledge sharing.

You will be employed by KMD in a full-time position, based at Charlie Tango's office in Østerbro,

Copenhagen, with a competitive salary package, pension and employee benefits in accordance with

KMD's employment terms. You will report to the Head of Design.

Interested?

We would love to see how you think, how you work, what you have created and how you envision an

AI-driven future.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a link to your portfolio,ideally including examples of digital product design as well as work involving Design Systems, Process Design, DesignOps or Accessibility.

Applications are handled through KMD's recruitment process. We welcome qualified candidates from

different backgrounds and experiences.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Manager, Head of Design, Frederik Aagaard at fag@kmd.dk or +45 51 22 99 02.

Come help us design digital experiences that matter, and shape how we design them.

Benefits:

KMD (an NEC company) is committed to providing equal opportunities. Hence, we invite all qualified interested applicants to apply for career opportunities. At KMD all aspects of employment and cooperation including the decision to hire/cooperate with will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected under local anti-discrimination legislation.

Are you an experienced network or server engineer, or a technical infrastructure lead, who wants to remain hands-on while taking responsibility for reliable service delivery? Would you like to combine solving technical problems with guiding colleagues and improving business-critical OT infrastructure supporting renewable energy?

As our new Service Manager – OT Gateway, you will be responsible for the reliable, secure and efficient delivery of site-level OT network and server services supporting Vattenfall’s renewable-energy operations. Your scope includes the networks, servers, on-site domain and other assigned site-based asset systems at our wind parks and other assets within the agreed service scope. These services underpin asset availability, monitoring and control, and operational data availability.

You will combine hands-on OT infrastructure engineering and incident resolution with functional leadership of a dedicated service team of network and server engineers. Alongside your own technical assignments, you will prioritise the team’s work, coordinate suppliers and support functions, and drive continual improvement while meeting agreed service levels.

Working closely with customers, stakeholders and the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, you will help develop standardised, proactive service delivery that combines effective incident response with preventive maintenance, lifecycle planning and long-term service improvement.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take responsibility for the delivery and performance of the services within your agreed scope, from their introduction into operation through ongoing support, improvement and eventual replacement or retirement.

In this role, “OT Gateway” refers to the site-level OT network and server service, including the on-site domain and other assigned site-based asset systems defined in the agreed service mapping. You will take responsibility for their operational support, controlled changes, upgrades, security patching, lifecycle management and continual improvement. You will manage interfaces and dependencies with SCADA, Power Plant Control and adjacent OT and IT services, maintaining clear ownership and support boundaries.

This role combines hands-on senior network and server infrastructure engineering with functional service leadership and does not include personnel line management. You will personally undertake engineering work within your technical expertise while coordinating and prioritising the service team’s activities, monitoring outcomes and making risks, dependencies and resource needs visible. Capability and capacity requirements will be aligned with the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, with resources requested from the respective line managers.

You will apply your practical engineering expertise to diagnose faults, restore services and implement controlled technical changes within your agreed scope and authorisation. You will provide technical guidance to colleagues, assess operational risks and challenge proposed solutions, combining hands-on delivery with effective planning and coordination across organisational boundaries.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation, personally diagnosing and resolving incidents affecting OT networks, servers and assigned systems and services outside normal working hours, within your agreed technical scope and authorisation. You will involve other engineers, suppliers and application or service owners when specialist support is required, follow agreed escalation arrangements and contribute to root-cause investigations and corrective and preventive actions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Service scope and support arrangements: Maintaining clear service definitions, ownership boundaries, agreed service levels, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements for site-level OT networks, servers and assigned asset systems. Defining interfaces with adjacent application and infrastructure services in line with the agreed service mapping, customer expectations and guidance from the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager.

• 
Service delivery and hands-on engineering: Managing reliable, secure and efficient day-to-day delivery of site-level OT network and server services, including monitoring, incidents, service requests, problems, changes and lifecycle activities. Personally configuring, testing, commissioning, maintaining and improving assigned network equipment, servers and related infrastructure services within your technical scope, approved procedures and authorisations, while balancing engineering assignments with service-leadership responsibilities and agreed priorities.

• 
Service performance: Monitoring performance against agreed service-level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational targets. Reporting on service availability, incident response and restoration, recurring issues, risks and improvement actions.

• 
Incident response and problem management: Personally diagnosing and resolving incidents affecting assigned networks, servers and infrastructure services, while coordinating additional engineers, suppliers, application owners and support functions as required. Establishing the infrastructure impact on supported operational systems, ensuring timely service restoration and clear stakeholder updates, investigating root causes and implementing or assigning corrective and preventive actions, with follow-up to completion.

• 
Backlog and delivery planning: Managing and prioritising the service team’s backlog, dependencies and delivery plans based on higher-level guidance, operational impact, risk and available capacity. Planning your own engineering assignments alongside service-leadership responsibilities, balancing urgent operational needs with planned maintenance, lifecycle work and improvements, and making capacity trade-offs visible.

• 
Capability and capacity planning: Identifying the skills and capacity required to deliver agreed services and roadmap commitments, aligning them with the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, and requesting resources from the respective line managers and making the consequences of resource gaps visible.

• 
Lifecycle engineering and controlled change: Executing the agreed service roadmap through hands-on engineering and coordination of network and server upgrades, migrations, patching, configuration changes and lifecycle replacements. Preparing, implementing or reviewing assigned infrastructure changes, with appropriate assessment of dependencies and operational impact, testing, rollback arrangements, documentation and operational handover through approved processes.

• 
Supplier and stakeholder coordination: Coordinating contributions from suppliers, specialists and internal support functions, monitoring delivery against agreed responsibilities and service commitments, and following up on issues. Supporting technical and service-related purchasing or contract discussions with the responsible procurement and contract owners.

• 
Project requirements and transition to operations: Providing OT network, server and infrastructure operations and maintenance requirements to projects whose deliverables will enter the service team’s scope. Agreeing operational acceptance criteria with relevant stakeholders and participating in readiness reviews and handovers, checking configuration and asset records, monitoring, documentation, backup and recovery arrangements, supplier support, operational responsibilities and unresolved risks.

• 
Operational documentation and knowledge: Producing and maintaining network diagrams, server and infrastructure configuration records, operational runbooks and troubleshooting guidance for your own engineering work. Ensuring that the service team maintains relevant service and asset records, documented dependencies, clear support responsibilities, escalation arrangements and accessible operational knowledge.

• 
Continual improvement and technical guidance: Using service-performance data and operational experience to identify, prioritise and implement improvements that reduce recurring incidents and strengthen reliability, efficiency and supportability. Standardising repeatable services and work packages, contributing to technical reviews, and supporting colleagues through practical guidance, knowledge sharing and appropriate automation.

• 
Security, compliance and audit support: Ensuring that applicable cybersecurity, regulatory and operational requirements are incorporated into service delivery and lifecycle planning, in collaboration with the responsible service engineers, cybersecurity and compliance functions. Coordinating relevant evidence and follow-up actions for audits and reviews.

• 
Risk management and escalation: Maintaining visibility of service risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and outstanding decisions. Escalating issues beyond the service team’s mandate or capacity to the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager and other responsible stakeholders, with clear recommendations and operational

Your profile / who are you?

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, information technology, network engineering, industrial IT, electrical engineering or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial hands-on experience in network or server infrastructure engineering and operational support.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, operating and supporting OT infrastructure or comparable business-critical network or server environments, including recent practical experience diagnosing faults, restoring services and implementing controlled changes. You bring strong expertise in network or server engineering, practical working knowledge of the other discipline and the ability to troubleshoot across their interfaces. You have also demonstrated the ability to coordinate technical work, prioritise operational needs and guide colleagues or suppliers. Your background may be as a senior infrastructure engineer, technical lead or service manager who has remained technically active; a previous formal Service Manager title is not required.

You understand the demands of supporting business-critical systems and can translate operational needs into clear priorities, responsibilities and delivery plans. You are comfortable taking responsibility for service outcomes while working with engineers, suppliers and line managers in a matrix organisation.

You have excellent written and spoken English skills and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role may be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• Operational service management: Applying structured incident, problem, service-request, change, configuration and lifecycle-management practices, with clear ownership, service levels and follow-up.

• Hands-on OT infrastructure engineering: Practical experience configuring, testing, commissioning, maintaining, operating and supporting OT network or server infrastructure, with the ability to work across networking and server dependencies. Personally implementing, documenting and validating technical changes within your area of expertise and working effectively with specialists in the other discipline.

Ability to assess the operational impact of infrastructure faults and changes, identify dependencies and work across clearly defined application, infrastructure and supplier responsibilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Engineers - Substations and Export Cables
jobs.description:
Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

We are looking for several Senior Project Engineers to strengthen our offshore transmission engineering capabilities within Business Area Wind, Offshore, Engineering.

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

We welcome engineers from all relevant disciplines across these scopes, with particular interest in HV and LV systems for onshore and offshore substations, and civil engineering for onshore substations and onshore export cable routes. Your assigned scope will reflect your background and experience.

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

In these roles, you will apply your experience to shape and challenge supplier solutions from the owner’s perspective, coordinate technical expertise and resolve delivery issues.

Within the project, you will report to the respective Package Manager and work autonomously within your assigned scope, drawing on technical specialists and collaborating with Interface Managers, Procurement and other project functions.

Your responsibilities:

• 
Deliver assigned engineering work packages in accordance with contractual requirements and project and contract milestones. Plan and coordinate activities, and monitor and report on safety, quality, progress and cost within your scope.

• 
Apply a systems engineering mindset so decisions within your scope support the performance, integration, optimisation and delivery of the overall transmission system—not individual contracts in isolation.

• 
Keep the design basis, requirements, interface decisions and contractual scope aligned, coordinating the impact of changes on affected packages.

• 
Work with Interface Managers and project teams to define and resolve technical and contractual interfaces, including scope boundaries, engineering inputs and delivery dependencies.

• 
Assess supplier proposals and technical decisions with safety as the highest, non-negotiable priority. Consider functionality, availability, quality, constructability and maintainability alongside CAPEX, OPEX, schedule and delivery risk.

• 
Coordinate technical specialist input and challenge unnecessary complexity and over-specification in supplier solutions.

• 
Identify and manage scope-related risks and opportunities, maintain an up-to-date risk and opportunity register, and coordinate mitigation. Keep technical positions, assumptions, deviations and residual risks visible throughout the project lifecycle.

• 
Support supplier qualification and technical evaluation. Incorporate Employer’s Requirements and specialist input into tender documentation, making scope boundaries and interface requirements clear. Assess bids, deviations and assumptions to support negotiations and award.

• 
Follow supplier engineering while respecting supplier design responsibility. Coordinate technical reviews, verify supplier documentation against contractual requirements, and resolve technical queries, deviations and changes with relevant stakeholders. Share lessons learned and contribute to improving requirements, engineering practices and project delivery.

jobs.occupation: Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products
jobs.description:
Would you like to put your studies into practice in an AI-first engineering environment and work with data engineering and AI-assisted development that creates real business value? Would you like to build your technical skills while contributing to solutions used across Nykredit? Then you might be our new Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products.

As a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products, you will play an important role in our team, helping us build reports, automate processes and develop the data flows and platforms that support fund valuation, alternatives and fund accounting.

Nykredit is investing heavily in AI, and our team takes an AI-first approach. We actively consider how AI can help us code, test and solve problems more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the results.

You will also become part of the Nykredit Group, where we offer opportunities and development for those who are curious and eager to learn. Through our student network, Nykredit Youth, you will be invited to professional events and networking opportunities with other students and young colleagues across the Group.

Are you motivated by data engineering and new technologies?

Then you have come to the right place. Your focus will be on reports, data processing, event-driven streaming pipelines and the platforms supporting our business domains.

You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, Azure and Kafka, alongside colleagues using GitHub, Terraform and Grafana for development, deployment and monitoring. These are technologies you will have the opportunity to work with and learn about, not a checklist of things you need to know before applying.

Your tasks will include:

• Developing and improving reports used by the business.

• Preparing, transforming and validating financial data.

• Automating manual tasks using Python and SQL.

• Helping build and test event-driven streaming pipelines and integrations using Kafka.Working with SimCorp Dimension and bringing its data into our Wealth Data Hub.

• Improving monitoring and automation of data flows and operational tasks.

• Exploring how AI can help us modernise legacy code, automate operations and improve data quality.

• Investigating data quality issues and improving existing solutions.

You will start with well-defined tasks and gradually take on more responsibility as you learn, working alongside experienced engineers on real deliveries.

The position is 10–15 hours per week at our headquarters, Nykredit Huset, Sundkrogsgade 25 in Nordhavn, where most of the team is based.

**AI as part of your everyday work

**We work with an AI-first approach: when tackling a task, we actively consider how AI can help us solve it better and more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the result.

You will get hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools and platforms for coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Together with experienced colleagues, you will explore how AI can help modernise legacy code, automate repetitive work and improve data quality.

We encourage you to experiment and bring your own ideas while learning to understand, review and validate AI-generated output. You do not need experience with specific AI tools before joining us. We will help you get started.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We imagine that you:

• are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field,

• have some experience with Python and SQL from coursework, personal projects or a previous student job,

• enjoy solving problems and working carefully with data,

• are comfortable asking questions and sharing what you learn,

• are curious about AI-assisted development and keen to use it in practice,

• are willing to experiment with AI while questioning, reviewing and understanding the output and code you work with.

We know you are still studying, so we do not expect you to know everything from day one. No financial background is needed, and familiarity with Git, cloud platforms or reporting projects is useful but not required.

What matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn alongside experienced colleagues. In your application, we would therefore like to hear about a project or assignment you have worked on, how you approached it and what you learned.

Your new team

You will join Fund Accounting Products in Nykredit Wealth Technology, where engineers and specialists work closely with the business.

We are modernising our solutions through the re-implementation of SimCorp Dimension, new SaaS solutions and the replacement of existing in-house systems. You will contribute to both existing solutions and new deliveries, with guidance from experienced colleagues and opportunities to learn how financial requirements translate into working code and reliable data.

We look forward to welcoming you as our new colleague.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contact Development Manager Søren Valther Rasmussen at +45 44 55 51 42 if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

As Cyber Security Professional in Security Architecture, you will help turn security requirements into practical designs for the technology and manufacturing environments Novo depends on. You will support architecture reviews, identify risks and recommend improvements that are proportionate and usable. Working alongside experienced architects, you will build on your technical foundation and take on broader responsibility as your experience grows. Your work helps colleagues make sound security decisions while innovation keeps moving.

What you’ll bring

• 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, systems engineering or a similar technical role.

• Practical experience in one or more relevant areas, such as Windows or Linux servers, endpoint security, Active Directory, network security, Zero Trust architectures, cloud platforms or manufacturing systems.

• A sound understanding of core security principles, including least privilege, secure configuration, segmentation and defence in depth.

• The ability to analyse technical problems, document your findings and communicate recommendations clearly.

• Good collaboration skills and professional proficiency in English.

• Contribute to security reference architectures, design patterns, standards and technical guidance that others can reuse.

• Work with infrastructure, application, cloud and manufacturing teams to embed security into solution designs.

• Support the design and assessment of Zero Trust Security Architectures, including network segmentation, secure access, and access decisions informed by identity and device security.

• Assess security considerations for emerging technologies, including AI services and applications.

• Document design decisions and explain security recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.

Who you’ll work with

In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

Security Architecture helps Novo make sound security decisions across technology and manufacturing environments, giving colleagues across the organisation clear direction, reusable designs and practical advice that support resilience and innovation.

The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
• The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
• You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.
AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

• How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
• How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
• What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?
This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

Would you like to join the Regulatory Report team in Reporting Solutions, responsible for several critical business solutions and reporting processes within Credit and Financial Risk? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Regulatory Reporting team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach (SA-CR) provided by NASDAQ (Axiom), Unlikeliness to Pay, ESG and other applications within Regulatory Reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with NASDAQ Axiom, Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**

• Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients

• Explore and analyse complex credit risk datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities. for improvement of business solutions and reporting processes

• Translate business and regulatory requirements into analytical use cases and communicate insights to stakeholders both internally in BEC and clients

• Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations

• Build analytical data products and models that support regulatory reporting and decision‑making across the credit risk domain

• Participate in the tech and data transformation in BEC towards a modern data platform using Azure and Databricks

• Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement

**To succeed you will have:

**

• 5+ years’ work experience as Business Analyst from Banking or financial IT

• Regulatory work experience from the banking sector in Denmark

• Extensive knowledge of the regulations: BASEL III, COREP (SA-CR), ESG, FINREP and other Regulatory reports

• Extensive experience working with large and complex datasets

• Understanding of data modelling concepts and data governance principles

• Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

**It’s nice-to-have:

**

• A relevant Master degree

• Working experience with NASDAQ Axiom platform

• Programming skills in SQL, Python or Power BI

• Work experience with modern platforms such as Databricks.
